## 这是自动构建的最新测试版。
- **这是一个预发布版本，并非为生产环境准备就绪。**
- 我们非常鼓励您分享您的看法！

## This is an automatically built latest Preview release.
- **This is a pre-release version and is not intended for production use.**
- We appreciate any feedback!

**更新日志（Changelog）:**
- i18n: Translations update from Hosted Weblate (#897) (Weblate (bot))
- feat(ui): add OS4 glass styling to Miuix settings (wxxsfxyzm)
- fix: respect target user in uninstall requests (wxxsfxyzm)
- fix(deps): update dependency org.jetbrains.kotlinx:kotlinx-serialization-json to v1.13.0 (#911) (renovate[bot])
- chore(deps): update gradle to v9.9.1 (#908) (renovate[bot])

**Full Changelog:** [`26.09...26.11.1f3f2a5`](https://github.com/wxxsfxyzm/InstallerX-Revived/compare/26.09...26.11.1f3f2a5)
